observations.task_scope: Unify installation, configuration, monitoring, credential rotation, backup, rollback, incident response, release status, and compliance boundaries.
observations.starting_point: Existing M5 documents cover build, systemd installation, and upgrade/rollback separately, but no single operator runbook or explicit release-readiness document covers monitoring, rotation, incident actions, and the rejected M6.2 gate.
observations.protocol_boundary: Documentation must keep LIMITED_MODE explicit and must not claim real-account switching, in-flight recovery, seamless continuity, or 24-hour qualification.

residual_risks: M6.4 documentation contracts have not yet run.
M6.2 remains rejected and must be listed as a release limitation.
